analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its highest ever half-yearly financial performance in H1 FY27, with Q2 FY27 revenue from operations increasing 16% YoY to ₹703 crore and profit after tax rising 135% YoY to ₹78 crore. Higher EBITDA margins during the period were primarily driven by Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) rates announced by the Government of India. The company expects turnover in the second half of the year to improve while maintaining an EBITDA margin of around 13%. Management is also evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies to diversify growth. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its highest ever half-yearly financial performance in H1 FY27, with H1 revenue reaching ₹1,235 crore and Q2 revenue rising 16% YoY to ₹703 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We expect to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.

guidance.claim: The company expects its second half turnover to be better than the first half.
guidance.quote: Our second half turnover will be better.

guidance.claim: Management believes achieving the annual revenue growth target should not be very difficult.
guidance.quote: However, considering our track record, marketing capabilities, sales team, and network of wholesalers and traders, we believe achieving the target should not be very difficult.

demand_outlook.claim: SSP production and sales saw a moderate decline across the industry, while NPK complex fertilizers experienced a sharper contraction.
demand_outlook.quote: Consequently, SSP production and sales saw a moderate decline across the industry while NPK complex fertilizers experienced a sharper contraction.

demand_outlook.claim: During the Kharif season, price gaps led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea, resulting in imbalanced soil nutrient profiles.
demand_outlook.quote: During the Kharif season, price gaps led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea resulting in imbalanced soil nutrient profiles.

demand_outlook.claim: Around 35% to 40% of the complex fertilizer market demand in India is currently served by overseas suppliers.
demand_outlook.quote: Around 35%–40% of the market is still served by overseas suppliers.

demand_outlook.claim: Uneven rainfall in agricultural regions moderated fertilizer consumption in phosphatic and potassic segments during Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Uneven rainfall in the agricultural regions affected Kharif sowing and moderated fertilizer consumption, particularly in the phosphatic and potassic segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has not planned any capacity expansion in the SSP segment so far.
capex_expansion.quote: No, we have not planned any capacity expansion in the SSP segment so far.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem is actively evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies.
capex_expansion.quote: Simultaneously, we are actively evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies to diversify our growth engines.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating certain expansion projects and plans to present a final proposal once evaluations are complete.
capex_expansion.quote: The management is currently evaluating certain projects, and we will present a final proposal at the appropriate time once the evaluation is complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The NPK and DAP capacity expansion has already been implemented.
capex_expansion.quote: The NPK/DAP capacity expansion has already been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 18% from 12% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA: Surged 74% YoY to ₹127 crore, with EBITDA margin improving to 18% from 12% in Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in EBITDA during H1 FY27 was primarily driven by the Nutrient-Based Subsidy rates announced by the Government of India.
margins_costs.quote: This is primarily due to the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) rates announced by the Government of India and made applicable during the period.

margins_costs.claim: The company's normal EBITDA margin typically ranges between 12% and 13%.
margins_costs.quote: Otherwise, our normal EBITDA margin would be in the range of 12%–13%.

margins_costs.claim: International prices for phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly.
margins_costs.quote: Regarding international raw material prices, phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate stayed broadly stable.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production in H1 FY27 stood at 1,81,906 metric tonnes, with sales of 1,70,783 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes: Fertiliser production stood at 1,81,906 metric tonnes, with sales of 1,70,783 metric tonnes.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has been able to maintain SSP capacity utilization above 100%.
orders_capacity.quote: This is one of the reasons we have been able to maintain SSP capacity utilisation above 100%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to maintain NPK/DAP capacity utilization in the range of 70% to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK/DAP, depending on market conditions, demand, sulphuric acid prices and other factors, we will try to maintain a reasonable capacity utilisation level, which may be in the range of 70%–80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has peak capacity utilisation in SSP and significant headroom to scale its manufactured NPK business.
orders_capacity.quote: With peak capacity utilisation in SSP and significant headroom to scale our manufactured NPK business, we are well-positioned to enhance production volumes, improve integration benefits and strengthen our market presence.

capital_allocation.claim: Short-term borrowings increased due to substantial material imports undertaken during the latter part of the half year.
capital_allocation.quote: Particularly during the latter part of the half year, we undertook substantial imports, which led to an increase in borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's current assets reached an all-time high level of ₹1,700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our current assets level is also Rs. 1,700 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and transit uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz increased freight and insurance costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical tensions in West Asia and transit uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz disrupted international trade flows, driving up freight and insurance costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: International prices for phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Regarding international raw material prices, phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate stayed broadly stable.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher NPK prices created pressure on pushing products into the market during H1.
risks_headwinds.quote: With the increase in NPK prices, we have also faced some pressure in pushing our products into the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty in global commodity markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty in global commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Continued volatility in key raw material prices poses an operational risk.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued volatility in key raw material prices.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.

management_commitments.claim: The government's announced subsidy rates are applicable until March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The subsidy rates announced by the government are applicable until March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management proposes to reduce the fertilizer cost charged to farmers in the second half.
management_commitments.quote: However, the situation is expected to normalise in the second half, during which we propose to reduce the cost to farmers.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to delivering higher turnover in the second half.
management_commitments.quote: Our second half turnover will be better.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
